title: Inverse-image constructor for actual strict quotient adjuncts
statement:
Fix a prime l and a finite extension E of ℚ_l, with scheme and coefficient universes independent. Complex, level, transition, ordinaryAlpha and the named constructor predicates refer to the actual strict ringed sequence-site complexes and maps [def-pur-strict-quotient-expressions]. S and D range over the normalized derived tensor and finite quotient calculi, whose units and tensor model are pinned [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. The following holds for all displayed schemes, maps, complexes and levels (level n denotes exponent n+1):

theorem strictPullbackAdjointConstructor {V W : Scheme.{t}} (g : V ⟶ W)
    (K : Complex l E W) :
    PullbackTransitions l E g K ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, PullbackModel l E g K n ∧ PullbackComputes l E g K n) ∧
    (∀ (SW : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensors l E W)
      (DW : CoefficientFiniteQuotientCalculus l E W SW)
      (SV : CoefficientDerivedSystemTensors l E V)
      (DV : CoefficientFiniteQuotientCalculus l E V SV) {m n : ℕ} (hmn : n ≤ m),
      PullbackAdjointEquation l E g K SW DW SV DV hmn)

proof.text: Apply strictPullbackEvaluationConstructor for horizontal naturality, finite pullback models, and exact computation of the left-derived comparison on every complex. Retain its explicit evaluation natural isomorphism and generator formula for the final equation.
Choose the scalar-pullback comparison supplied by strictScalarPullbackComparison, with its prescribed generator formula.

Check the final equation degreewise. The finite inverse-image and scalar-extension Hom bijections reduce equality to unit generators. Use naturality of scalar insertion, the evaluation generator formula, the scalar comparison generator formula, naturality of finite inverse-image units, and the existing ordinary adjunct and transition section formulas. Horizontal naturality then identifies both sides.
